verdict.rationale: Chargebee explicitly models entitlements as features tied to plans/subscriptions (chargebee-docs-10, chargebee-docs-23, chargebee-docs-14) and offers a general REST API plus SDKs (chargebee-docs-1, chargebee-docs-2, chargebee-docs-20) that could be used to query subscription/customer data. However, the evidence never shows a dedicated entitlements API endpoint or SDK method for runtime entitlement checks. Missing for 10: explicit entitlements API/SDK reference or endpoint documentation, example code checking a customer's feature access at runtime.
